title: Settings
songGroupInvalid: Song group must contain a name, a mode, and at least one song.
dayAlgorithmHint: The new algorithm status will apply at the start of the next day-radio cycle.
dayAlgorithmInfo: The library is split into sections of N songs each. Songs within each section are evenly distributed across genre groups. Songs inside a section are shuffled with cross-section boundary fixes applied.
groupSectionsAlgorithmHint: The new algorithm status will apply at the start of the next day-radio cycle.
groupSectionsAlgorithmInfo: The queue is built from mini-sections. Each section contains one song from each genre group. The max number of sections equals the smallest group size. Genre groups do not repeat across section boundaries.
simpleAlgorithmHint: The new algorithm status will apply at the start of the next day-radio cycle.
simpleAlgorithmInfo: Songs are shuffled randomly without considering genre groups.
nightDayAlgorithmHint: The new algorithm status will apply at the start of the next night-radio cycle.
nightDayAlgorithmInfo: The library is split into sections of N songs each. Songs within each section are evenly distributed across night-radio genre groups. Songs inside a section are shuffled with cross-section boundary fixes applied.
nightGroupSectionsAlgorithmHint: The new algorithm status will apply at the start of the next night-radio cycle.
nightGroupSectionsAlgorithmInfo: The night-radio queue is built from mini-sections. Each section contains one song from each night-radio genre group. The max number of sections equals the smallest group size. Genre groups do not repeat across section boundaries.
nightSimpleAlgorithmHint: The new algorithm status will apply at the start of the next night-radio cycle.
groupDefsHint: Edit group keys and artists. One artist per line.
groupDefsKeyHint: Short unique key (e.g. A1, B, D2)
groupDefsUnassignedHint: Day-radio artists not yet in any group
groupDefsUnassignedHintNight: Night-radio artists not yet in any group
groupDefsUnassignedEmpty: All artists are assigned to groups
groupDefsDragHint: Drag an artist into a group
sectionHint: Bounds depend on group count and the smallest non-empty group.
invalidJson: GROUP_DEFS must be a valid JSON object.
appliedLater: Settings were saved, but the changes will take effect later
oneHourWarning: If total duration is below 1 hour, playlist generation is blocked.
radioHostsHint: How long a guest/special guest may stay live before the session ends automatically.
backgroundMusicModeHint: What plays instead of the main queue while hosts/guests are paused and talking.
backgroundMusicModeRandomHint: A random track from the library plays in the background.
backgroundMusicModeHostChoiceHint: The host picks which track plays, from a list in the host panel.
readOnlyNotice: Read-only: this host discards its filesystem, so saved settings would not survive a restart. Use a remote database to enable editing.
artistArtsDayEnabled: Turn on arts for the daytime broadcast
artistArtsNightEnabled: Turn on arts for the night broadcast
